@graph.headline: Varanasi to Prayagraj Tempo Traveller: Maha Kumbh Status and Magh Mela Travel
@graph.description: Maha Kumbh was held in Prayagraj in 2025, not 2026. This page explains current group-transfer planning and the distinction from the annual Magh Mela.

mainEntity.name: Was there a Maha Kumbh in Prayagraj in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Prayagraj Maha Kumbh ran from January 13 to February 26, 2025. The annual Magh Mela is a different event.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a Varanasi to Prayagraj Tempo Traveller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ordinary group transfers are available. Festival passes, parking zones and bathing-day routes can only be confirmed after the administration publishes the applicable plan.
